title: Thymosin beta‑4 improves endothelial function and reparative potency of diabetic endothelial cells differentiated from patient induced pluripotent stem cells

citation.title: Thymosin beta‑4 improves endothelial function and reparative potency of diabetic endothelial cells differentiated from patient induced pluripotent stem cells

printed_heading.text: Su etal.StemCellResearch&Therapy (2022)13:13 https://doi.org/10.1186/s13287-021-02687-x RESEARCH Thymosin beta‑4 improves endothelial function and reparative potency of diabetic endothelial cells differentiated from patient induced pluripotent stem cells Liping Su1 , Xiaocen Kong2 , Szejie Loo1 ,Yu Gao3 , Bingli Liu2 , Xiaofei Su2 , Rinkoo Dalan4 , Jianhua Ma2* and LeiYe1*

what_it_measured.text: In the current study, we aimed to assess the role of thymosin β-4 (Tb-4) on endothelial function using dia-hiPSC-ECs as disease model of endothelial dysfunction.
For assessment of cyto-protection by Tb4 on diabetic hiPSC-ECs, 5 × 104 hiPSC-ECs/well were cultured in 24-well plate.

dose.text: Animals were randomly assigned to treatment with 1.2 × 106 DP2-EC or DP3-EC (the DP2EC or DP3-EC group), or with Tb4 treated 1.2 × 106 DP2-EC or DP3-EC in 0.1 mL EBMs + 5 mg gelatin microspheres loaded with 5 μg Tb4 protein in 0.1 mL EBM (the DP2-EC + Tb4 or DP3-EC + Tb4 group), or only 0.1 mL EBM (the control group), or 5 mg gelatin microspheres loaded with 5 μg Tb4 protein in 0.1 mL EBM (the Tb4 group).

Tb4 (600 ng/mL) protects dia‑hiPSC‑EC from hypoxic damage To determine cyto-protection effect of Tb4 on ECs, diahiPSC-ECs were cultured in EBM supplemented with or without Tb4 in hypoxic condition for 24 h.

endpoint.text: Thus, we measured ICAM-1 protein expression and mitochondrial membrane potential in dia-hiPSC-ECs after treated with Tb4.

Tb4 (600 ng/mL) treated Dia‑hiPSC‑EC improves angiogenic potential for treatment of HLI The potential of Tb4 treated and non-treated dia-hiPSC- ECs for treatment of ischemic disease was evaluated in a mouse model of HLI (Fig. 7A) [25].

reported_results.text: Although Tb4-microsphere group increased perfusion to 45 ± 11.8%, no significant improvement was achieved as compared with the Medium, DP2-EC, and DP3-EC groups and was significantly lower than the DP2-EC + Tb4-microsphere group (p < 0.05).

Tb4 (600 ng/mL) protects dia‑hiPSC‑EC from hypoxic damage To determine cyto-protection effect of Tb4 on ECs, diahiPSC-ECs were cultured in EBM supplemented with or without Tb4 in hypoxic condition for 24 h.
Thus, we measured ICAM-1 protein expression and mitochondrial membrane potential in dia-hiPSC-ECs after treated with Tb4.

Tb4 (600 ng/mL) treated Dia‑hiPSC‑EC improves angiogenic potential for treatment of HLI The potential of Tb4 treated and non-treated dia-hiPSC- ECs for treatment of ischemic disease was evaluated in a mouse model of HLI (Fig. 7A) [25].

Although Tb4-microsphere group increased perfusion to 45 ± 11.8%, no significant improvement was achieved as compared with the Medium, DP2-EC, and DP3-EC groups and was significantly lower than the DP2-EC + Tb4-microsphere group (p < 0.05).
